quests.title: Hilichurl Justice

dialogue.t: Tomo mosi mita! Tomo mani mimi?
Plata odomu! Zido mi! Mi muhe yeye! Mi mita yeye!
Seems they're really getting into their conversation...

dialogue.sit: That was a very smooth interaction indeed.

dialogue.t: It needs us to defeat one of its enemies, and it's marked the location for us.
Odomu tomo zido mi! <color=#00E1FFFF>Unta mosi dada</color>!
<color=#00E1FFFF>Unta mosi dada</color>... What does that mean again... Well, thanks either way!

quests.description: You prepare to help a bullied hilichurl to even the score together with Ella Musk. With any luck, this may lead you to some new clues…
